summary: Validate a HomeBrain iOS archive's release identity, signature, and absence of Siri/App Intents integration before App Store submission.
inputs: An .xcarchive path plus explicit --expected-version and --expected-build values.
outputs: A human-readable or JSON validation report and exit status 0 only for a conforming archive.
side_effects: None; the archive and repository are read-only.

environment: Xcode command-line tools including codesign and otool
